note: 2026-09-16 SESSION-OPEN BATCH, written and fired by the CHAIRMAN before any seat is convened and before the analyst has read anything. EPISTEMIC STATUS: this IS session-open pre-registration and may be cited as such. CHANNEL PROBES AT SESSION OPEN, both on NEUTRAL CONTROLS, nothing inherited: (1) curl https://example.com -> 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' (exit 56), and the proxy's own status endpoint logged it under recentRelayFailures as connect_rejected, host example.com:443, at 2026-09-16T11:10:23.463Z, with a second identical entry for en.wikipedia.org:443 at 2026-09-16T11:10:23.730Z; (2) the fetch service returned {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED","domain":"example.com"} on the same neutral control. This session therefore has no fetch capability of its own; that is a fact about this container and not about any resource on the internet. The relay is the day's retrieval instrument. RULING 1 OF 2026-09-15 IS APPLIED MECHANICALLY AND BEFORE ANY ROW WAS DESIGNED, WHICH IS THE CHANGE I AM MAKING TODAY. Yesterday my session-open row failed the first-occurrence test in the same note that invoked it, because I screened the candidate literal against the SPENT-PAIR LIST instead of against the ASSEMBLED ON-STATE RUN. Today I assembled first. Every non-empty excerpt this project holds for this docket URL was read out of analytics/fetch-results/ (17 rows, 15 distinct strings, from the five batches of 2026-09-13, 09-14 and 09-15), stitched by maximal overlap, and reduced to SIX disjoint assembled runs totalling 3,608 characters: 683, 653, 642, 616, 614 and 400. The candidate literal was then tested against that assembly, not against a list of spellings. CAVEAT ON THE ASSEMBLY, STATED BECAUSE IT IS REAL: the 17 rows come from three different whole-body sha256 values at a constant 98,122 bytes (da8b441f.., 4b260927.., d972c70f..), so the assembly is a union across three renderings of a page with at least one length-preserving mutable field, not a transcript of one byte-stream. It is sound for the containment test it is used for here and it is not a claim that any run is contiguous on today's rendering. ROW 1 'April 13, 2026' - THE SUBSTANTIVE ROW, and it is next step 7 of yesterday's close-out. Assembled run 1 ends '... March 11, 2026 The ad hoc Committee issues Procedural Order No. 1 concerning procedural matters. April 13, 2026 Spentech Engineering Limite' - cut mid-word by our own EXCERPT_CHARS = 400 cap and NOT by the page. A fourth annulment chronology entry exists and is unobserved. PRICED IN CHARACTERS BEFORE REGISTRATION, as next steps 2 and 3 require, and by assembly rather than by the one-sided formula: the literal's first character sits at index 641 of run 1, whose right edge is 42 characters further on, and excerpt_of returns body[p-100 : p+300). LEFTWARD YIELD ZERO - run 1 extends 641 characters to the left of p, which covers the whole of [p-100, p). RIGHTWARD YIELD 300 - 42 = 258 NEW CHARACTERS. The row is registered at a pre-declared yield of 258 characters and is to be graded against that number. The literal occurs ONCE in the entire 3,608-character assembly and 'April 13' occurs once; that is evidence about the assembly and NOT a demonstration that the page's first occurrence of the literal is this one, since 3,608 characters is a small fraction of the page. IF the first occurrence is elsewhere, the row returns a window from that other place, the 258 is wrong, and I will grade it as wrong rather than reinterpret it. FORECAST: find_matched TRUE, registered at HIGH. This is an OBSERVED region - the council holds the literal verbatim in a committed window - so the LOW-or-nothing rule for unobserved regions does not bind it. I record that the forecast is near-guaranteed and of correspondingly low evidential value. PRE-DISARMED, AND THIS IS THE DAY'S LIKELIEST OVERREACH: next step 5 of yesterday's close-out forbids writing what the 25 February 2026 decision DECIDED, because the docket gives 'issues a decision ON the continuation of the stay' - a subject, not an outcome. THE SAME PROHIBITION IS HEREBY EXTENDED IN ADVANCE TO WHATEVER THE 13 APRIL 2026 ENTRY TURNS OUT TO SAY. If it reads 'files' or 'submits' or 'issues a decision on', that is a filing or a subject and not a disposition, and no seat may write an outcome the window does not carry. Next step 6 also binds anything returned: a bare 'Procedural Order No. N' on ARB/24/16 is forbidden - the annulment and the original proceeding each have a No. 1 and a No. 3. ROW 2 'Construction' - POSITIVE CONTROL, not a prediction and not scored as one. A spent pair that buys no new window; what it buys is validation of the find-instrument ON TODAY'S BYTE-STREAM, IN THE SAME RUN as row 1, so that any null above is a validated null rather than an unvalidated silence. Folding the control into the substantive batch rather than firing it as a second runner invocation is yesterday's repair and it is kept. ROWS 3 AND 4 - NOT RESEARCH. These are evidence for ESCALATION 5 of yesterday's close-out, which reports that two of this project's own source carriers contradict each other: specs/iisd_itn.yaml:24 says 'Use /itn/feed/ not /itn/en/feed/ (the /en/ variant 403s)', while the docstring of src/sources/iisd_itn.py says that since about August 2026 EVERY feed variant and the article pages themselves answer with a Cloudflare bot-challenge at HTTP 403, the homepage excepted. Seven relay rows were fired at the /en/ spelling on an earlier day on the strength of the spec. The two rows below fire at the two spellings the docstring distinguishes, through the relay's unaltered polite_get - the SAME code path the weekly collection run uses - so the contradiction is priced against a dated observation instead of against two comments. FORECASTS: row 3, https://www.iisd.org/itn/feed/ -> REFUSED at 403, registered at HIGH, on two independent supports - the docstring, and digests/2026-09-14_ISDS-Thematic-Watch/meta.json, whose source_health entry for iisd_itn records exactly this URL with outcome 'refused', detail '403'. Row 4, https://www.iisd.org/itn/ -> HTTP 200 with real HTML, registered at MODERATE-HIGH, on the docstring's homepage exception and on that same meta.json recording the source as RETURNED with 17 items on the day its feed was refused. BINDING LIMIT ON BOTH ROWS, because this is the tool-status-as-source-state trap in its purest form: whatever these two rows return is a fact about what one host answered ONE GitHub runner at ONE time. It is not a fact about IISD, not a fact about Investment Treaty News, and not a ruling on the Grosse Ruse-Khan slug, which next step 8 returns to CARRIED-UNRESOLVED and which is to be RE-PRICED, not re-asserted. A 403 here does not disqualify a resource and a 200 here does not release one. WHOLE-PAGE FORECAST on the docket URL, registered once and graded once, riding on rows 1 and 2: predicted bytes 98122, MODERATE-HIGH - the page has held that length across every one of the three renderings this project has seen. Predicted sha256 DIFFERENT from d972c70f85f5.., MODERATE-HIGH - the digest changed between 09-13 and 09-14 and again between 09-14 and 09-15 at constant byte length, and this batch fires on a later calendar date. That rows 1 and 2 return an identical sha256 TO EACH OTHER within one run is NEAR-GUARANTEED, of low evidential value, and registered as such rather than scored. BINDING READING RULE, carried unchanged for a tenth batch: any window returned may contain case names, case numbers, document types and dates belonging to matters this project is not researching. NONE may be entered as a discovered matter, screened, graded on any ring, or carried as a lead, including in any candidate-claims block. This instrument retrieves what the record already identified; it is not a discovery channel (METHODOLOGY Part VIII). WHAT THIS BATCH CANNOT DO, stated so it is not expected to: it cannot reach the ground or the reasoning of the 28 July 2025 award, and it cannot reach what Procedural Order No. 3 of 28 August 2026 decided. Those live on documents the relay discards at scripts/fetch_relay.py:124-125 for content type, at addresses the tag-strip destroys. Limb (ii) of the Spentech thread is instrument-blocked and no batch anyone can design against this docket closes it. The award remains the operator's to read.
